name: Castilléjar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided blue and white, charged over the division with the crowned arms of the town of Castilléjar (a castle above waves and the letter R).
history: Castilléjar adopted its arms and flag officially on 20 June 2008; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, parted at the centre, with the arms of the town over all at the centre occupying half the height of the cloth.

features.role: Castilléjar arms — castle above waves and the letter R
